title: REQ · Colour, spacing and type tokens are defined once from the palette and exposed to CSS and Tailwind
summary: Single token module feeding CSS variables and Tailwind theme
description: Context: styles.css has a few hsl variables; Tailwind exposes palette ramps as pal.*. Desired: one tokens module with colour (from PALETTE_RAMPS), spacing and type, emitted as :root CSS variables and referenced in theme.extend. Expected: components use tokens only. Why: consistent styling.
acceptance_criteria: Given the tokens module, when colour tokens are listed, then each value is contained in PALETTE
Given tokensToCssVars, when called, then it returns --sf-color-*, --sf-space-* and --sf-font-* entries
Given tailwind.config, when imported, then theme.extend exposes sf colours, spacing and fontFamily referencing the CSS variables and the existing background token stays
technical_constraints: One palette of at most 48 colours, defined once
definition_of_done: Tokens exposed as CSS variables and Tailwind values
